title: Digestive and Metabolic Emergence: Slow-Wave Transport, Peristalsis, and the Glucose Homeostat
abstract: Digestive organs emerge on the shared VP jamming (R19) substrate; this volume adds slow-wave transport, peristalsis, the glucose homeostat, counter-regulation, and a single carcinogen barrier-Kramers kernel for three organ sites. It closes by inheriting a sibling DNA-grounded 27-target non-opioid analgesic map and reading it on the volume's own visceral-afferent spinodal, turning the shared substrate into a cited drug-class pointer for digestive visceral pain (clinical magnitudes and felt pain [O]). A final section closes the in-substrate digestive Tier-1 surface by reuse (dyssynergic defecation, Hirschsprung, MODY, hepatic GSD type I, autoimmune gastritis), no new primitive.
headline_results: one ICC lesion → gastroparesis + slow-transit + pseudo-obstruction
fast carbohydrate delivery → dumping/reactive-hypoglycaemia crossing (one loop)
one gate, two failures: GERD (reflux) ↔ achalasia (stasis)
stiff fundic reservoir → premature meal pressure (functional dyspepsia, post-prandial distress)
one R19 curvature, two readings: afferent gain (IBS hypersensitivity) = fundic compliance
barrier continuum reaches cancer: Barrett's/Correa metaplasia (rate-limiting precursor) + HBV×aflatoxin / smoke×alcohol synergy + reversible H. pylori MALT
self-sustaining basins: IBD relapse hysteresis (induction≠maintenance) + colitis→barrier→cancer bridge, and acute-pancreatitis autocatalytic latch (irreversible past threshold)

physics of the wall and the fluid: mesenteric-ischaemia supply−demand flip (time-critical salvage window) + gallstone nucleation barrier (UDCA only on small early stones) + diverticular Laplace herniation (fibre reverses the geometry)

cross-system seams wired (citation/pointer-only, no sibling import): circulatory hepatic interface (Q_H=1500 mL/min, E=0.75, F=0.25) consumed as the NAFLD/MASLD + bile delivery substrate, the mind felt-symptom seam a one-way pointer, the firewall an architectural lock (0 sibling imports; metabolic state mind-free)

analgesic target logic INHERITED (analgesic_threshold_logic v2.0, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20733420): 27 non-opioid pain targets re-derive on this package's own §18 afferent spinodal (drift 0) — three drug-class levers (reduce inward current / open K_V7 / remove NGF-CGRP drive), each raising the §18 firing threshold, a cited-drug-class pointer for IBS / functional abdominal pain / biliary colic / oesophageal-spasm pain (every clinical magnitude + the felt pain [O], firewall held)

in-substrate Tier-1 surface CLOSED (§29, no new primitive): dyssynergic defecation (§16 gate at the anorectal outlet) + Hirschsprung (§4 segmental aganglionic block, proximal dilatation) + MODY (a distinct regulated §12 curve) + hepatic GSD-I (§6 fasting hypoglycaemia + failed counter-reg) + autoimmune gastritis (§22 corpus flare, achlorhydria) — three monogenic items gene-key → disease_wp

chapters.title: Organ emergence from measured γ
chapters.one_liner: Four digestive organs emerge deterministically from their measured master-gene composition γ on the shared R19 jamming switch: stomach (BARX1, γ=1.5609), intestine (CDX2, γ=1.45), pancreas (PDX1, γ=1.4732) and liver (HHEX, γ=1.525).

chapters.title: Gastric slow-wave pacemaker (~3 cpm)
chapters.one_liner: The gastric pacemaker is a robust limit cycle on the shared FitzHugh–Nagumo oscillator: at a long recovery constant τ_s=380 it beats at the cited ~3 cpm anchor, with inter-spike-interval variability under 3% across a wide drive sweep (0.40–0.70).

chapters.title: Aboral slow-wave frequency gradient
chapters.one_liner: The intestinal slow-wave frequency falls monotonically aboral, reproducing the duodenum-to-ileum gradient.

chapters.title: Peristaltic aboral transport
chapters.one_liner: A slow-wave phase gradient produces net aboral transport.

chapters.title: Glucose–insulin homeostat setpoint
chapters.one_liner: A glucose load returns to the ~5 mM setpoint via the insulin loop.

chapters.title: Hypoglycaemia counter-regulation
chapters.one_liner: Hypoglycaemia triggers glucagon-driven hepatic glucose release that returns blood glucose to setpoint.

chapters.title: Carcinogen barrier-Kramers kernel
chapters.one_liner: A carcinogen is a sustained aberrant drive that lowers the R19 cell-fate barrier, raising the Kramers crossing rate into a malignant basin; relative risk is RR(dose)=rate(dose)/rate(0).

chapters.title: Colorectal processed-meat dose-response
chapters.one_liner: Processed-meat exposure raises colorectal-cancer risk along a monotone, convex dose-response anchored to the IARC figure RR≈1.18 per 50 g/day.

chapters.title: Pancreatic smoking dose-response
chapters.one_liner: Tobacco exposure raises pancreatic-cancer risk monotonically in pack-years, anchored to RR≈1.91 at 50 pack-years.

chapters.title: Gastric H. pylori–diet synergy
chapters.one_liner: Helicobacter pylori infection and dietary N-nitroso act synergistically on gastric-cancer risk: infection lowers the R19 barrier scale while diet adds bias, and their joint relative risk (≈4.4) exceeds the additive-null (3.3).

chapters.title: Gastric dysrhythmia and gastroparesis
chapters.one_liner: Gastric dysrhythmia and gastroparesis are perturbations of one slow-wave pacemaker.

chapters.title: Diabetes: capacity and gain on one homeostat
chapters.one_liner: Type 1 and type 2 diabetes are two failure modes of one glucose homeostat.

chapters.title: Gastritis and peptic ulcer: the barrier axis
chapters.one_liner: Gastritis and peptic ulcer reuse the carcinogenesis barrier kernel: acid and NSAID aggression biases the mucosal-integrity barrier downward, so erosion risk rises along a convex Kramers curve anchored to the cited NSAID ulcer risk near four.

chapters.title: Intestinal motility and transit disorders
chapters.one_liner: The major non-obstructive intestinal motility disorders perturb one peristalsis module.

chapters.title: Additional Tier-1 perturbations (dumping, reflux, insulinoma, FD, SIBO)
chapters.one_liner: Five further Tier-1 disorders perturb already-built modules: dumping drives a faster, higher glucose peak plus a biphasic reactive-hypoglycaemia crossing on the §5 loop; reflux oesophagitis reuses the §13 erosion kernel; insulinoma mirrors type-1 diabetes; functional dyspepsia is a mild point on the §11 ICC axis; SIBO stasis rises as the §4 sweep weakens.

chapters.title: Sphincter-gate disorders (GERD, achalasia, spasm, Oddi)
chapters.one_liner: The esophageal and outlet motor disorders ride one Tier-2 primitive: a gate, the R19 switch held closed, opening only past tone plus spinodal.

chapters.title: Gastric accommodation reservoir (functional dyspepsia, post-prandial distress)
chapters.one_liner: The post-prandial-distress component of functional dyspepsia rides a new Tier-2 primitive: a reservoir, the R19 wall relaxed toward yield.

chapters.title: Visceral afferent gain (IBS subtypes, functional abdominal pain)
chapters.one_liner: Irritable bowel syndrome rides a new Tier-2 primitive: a visceral afferent gain, the R19 element's susceptibility χ = 1/k.

chapters.title: Metaplasia precursor step (Barrett's → EAC, gastric Correa cascade)
chapters.one_liner: A metaplastic precursor — Barrett's oesophagus, gastric intestinal metaplasia — is the same R19 cell-fate switch with its stability scale lowered by injury, the g-reduction the §10 kernel uses for H.

chapters.title: Carcinogen synergy generalized (HCC: HBV×aflatoxin; ESCC: smoking×alcohol)
chapters.one_liner: Two carcinogenic drives read off the same exact R19 barrier reproduce epidemiological super-additivity and predict sub-multiplicativity near the spinodal.

chapters.title: Reversibility, single-driver, and the honest kernel boundary (MALT, anal; GIST/NET/small-bowel/cholangio)
chapters.one_liner: The kernel's signature is reversibility: gastric MALT lymphoma is an H.

chapters.title: Immune relapsing-inflammation layer (IBD relapse hysteresis, induction/maintenance asymmetry, colitis→cancer bridge)
chapters.one_liner: Inflammatory bowel disease is the R19 switch with a self-sustaining flare basin: the relapsing-remitting course is a hysteresis (the flip-to-flare drive exceeds the return-to-remission drive, so a flare persists as the trigger recedes), which forces the induction-vs-maintenance asymmetry — the same dose holds remission but cannot break a flare.

chapters.title: Exocrine autodigestion layer (acute pancreatitis autocatalytic latch, large-reserve EPI, PERT rescue)
chapters.one_liner: Acute pancreatitis is the R19 switch with an autocatalytic self-amplification (active trypsin activates trypsinogen).

chapters.title: Perfusion / vascular layer (mesenteric ischaemia, ischaemic colitis, NAFLD/MASLD metabolic overlap)
chapters.one_liner: The perfusion / vascular layer rides a new Tier-3 primitive: a perfusion-viability switch — the R19 element in the viable basin with bias h = perfusion − demand.

chapters.title: Hepatobiliary / bile layer (cholelithiasis nucleation barrier, dissolution hysteresis, biliary seams)
chapters.one_liner: The hepatobiliary / bile layer rides a new Tier-3 primitive: a nucleation barrier.

chapters.title: Structural / mechanical layer (diverticular disease Laplace wall-mechanics, fibre treatment, obstruction boundary)
chapters.one_liner: The structural / mechanical layer rides a new Tier-3 primitive: a wall-mechanics switch driven by Laplace's law.

chapters.title: Cross-system seams (wired): circulatory hepatic delivery substrate + mind felt-symptom firewall
chapters.one_liner: The seams the §24 / §25 / §18 sections declared are now wired — citation/pointer-only, never a sibling code import.

chapters.title: Analgesic target logic for visceral pain (inherited): a DNA-grounded 27-target firing-threshold map sorted into three drug-class levers
chapters.one_liner: This section inherits a sibling whitepaper — analgesic_threshold_logic v2.0 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20733420), a DNA-grounded map of 27 non-opioid analgesic targets — and applies it to digestive visceral pain.

chapters.title: Remaining in-substrate perturbations (dyssynergic defecation, Hirschsprung, MODY, hepatic GSD-I, autoimmune gastritis)
chapters.one_liner: This section closes the in-substrate digestive Tier-1 surface by REUSE — no new primitive, no sibling package.

chapters.title: Live cross-package harness: load every VP volume in one process and verify the shared substrate, hepatic seam, analgesic map and felt-symptom endpoint against the live sibling engines (out of gate)
chapters.one_liner: This section is the live cross-package harness — the last frontier item of the work order.
